title: Live-update Git Changes and Git History (file watcher + refs pill)
body:
Spec (design settled 2026-09-27; turn into a plan before implementing). Decisions: hand-rolled ReadDirectoryChangesW watcher (no `notify` crate); History shows a pill, not a silent swap.

## Goal
Git Changes updates live while shown. Git History detects ref changes while shown and offers a "↻ N new commits" pill. No work while neither window is shown. Today: Changes refreshes on activate (REFOCUS_DEBOUNCE, src/git_history/changes.rs); History is manual (`restart`, src/git_history.rs).

## Detection: src/git_history/watch.rs, `RepoWatch`
- Registry keyed by canonical worktree root -> Weak<RepoWatch>; each view holds an Arc. Last Arc dropped -> thread stops; drop/join off the GUI thread (existing retire pattern).
- Exposes two generation counters, `worktree_gen` and `refs_gen` (not bools: two windows on one watcher must not eat each other's signal). Bump -> ctx.request_repaint().
- Roots: `git rev-parse --show-toplevel --absolute-git-dir --git-common-dir` once. Watch the worktree root recursively, plus the common dir if outside it. Linked worktree: HEAD/index from the worktree gitdir, refs/packed-refs from the common dir (same split as JetBrains GitRepositoryUpdater).
- Thread: CreateFileW(FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS | FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, share read|write|delete), ReadDirectoryChangesW(subtree=TRUE, FILE_NAME|DIR_NAME|LAST_WRITE|SIZE), 64 KiB buffer, WaitForMultipleObjects on [io event, stop event] with the debounce as timeout. Add the `Win32_System_IO` feature to windows-sys (feature, not a new crate).
- Debounce: trailing 300 ms, max-wait 2 s.
- Overflow (0 bytes returned): wait 500 ms, then bump both gens (= full re-read). Same as JetBrains fsnotifier RECDIRTY.
- Classify each event path:
  - under a git dir: HEAD -> both gens; index -> worktree_gen; refs/{heads,remotes,tags}/**, packed-refs, reftable/**, MERGE_HEAD, rebase-merge/, rebase-apply/ -> refs_gen; config, info/exclude -> rebuild ignore set. Ignore objects/, logs/, FETCH_HEAD, ORIG_HEAD, *.lock (git writes index.lock then renames to index; the rename is the event).
  - elsewhere: worktree_gen unless under an ignored prefix. Any `.gitignore` event rebuilds the ignore set.
  - Compare git-dir prefixes case-insensitively; events may arrive as 8.3 short names.
- Ignored prefixes: `git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard --directory -z` (~75 ms here). Load-bearing: card worktrees live INSIDE the main checkout at .foreman/worktrees/<id> (excluded via .git/info/exclude), so without this every agent write wakes the main project's Changes window. target/ likewise.
- Watch root deleted -> read fails -> close the handle and exit; never retry. (A Project opened directly on a card worktree would otherwise hold the tree teardown wants to delete -> TeardownOutcome::Held.)
- ReadDirectoryChangesW unavailable (network share, \\wsl$) -> no watcher; views keep today's refresh-on-activate.
- Keep the classify + debounce core pure (no Win32) and table-test it.

## Changes (src/git_history/changes.rs)
- On worktree_gen change while shown: if no read in flight, start one; else set `again` and start one when it lands. NEVER cancel on a watcher trigger: today's `refresh()` cancels the in-flight read, so steady churn slower than one status read would starve forever.
- Hash raw status bytes; identical -> keep the old Status, don't rebuild the tree.
- Spinner only for first/manual reads, not watcher reads.
- Refresh-on-activate stays only as the no-watcher fallback.
- Whole-tree status, not JetBrains' dirty-path-scoped status: measured ~76 ms on this repo, dominated by Windows process spawn. Revisit only if a big repo proves it.

## History pill (src/git_history.rs)
- Fingerprint = hash of `git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(refname)'` minus refs/stash (filter in Rust; installed git lacks --exclude) + HEAD. Taken by the stream worker BEFORE `git log` starts, so refs moving mid-read are caught by the next event.
- On refs_gen change while shown: re-fingerprint on a worker. Differs -> `git rev-list --count <scope revisions> --not <old tip ids>`. Pill: "↻ N new commits", or "↻ History changed" when N = 0 (reset/rebase/deleted branch/tag-only change).
- Pill click -> restart(scope, keep_selection: true) (Refresh button stays keep_selection: false).
- Optional, recommended: when scroll_y is at the top, restart silently instead of showing the pill (JetBrains' SelectionSnapshot.isOnTop rule; ~3 lines).
- Hidden window: nothing runs; a moved gen is handled on next show.

## Tests / evidence
- Pure table test: event path -> (worktree_gen, refs_gen, rebuild-ignore) incl. worktree layout, *.lock, logs/, ignored prefixes, case/short names.
- Debounce: a burst of 1000 target/ events -> 0 reads; a burst in src/ -> 1 read per window.
- No feedback loop: our reads (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 status, for-each-ref, log, diff reads) produce no watcher bumps.
- Card lifecycle regression: RepoWatch open on the main repo, tear down a card worktree -> TeardownOutcome::Removed.
- Watch-root deleted -> thread exits, handle closed.
- Native screenshot: agent edit appears in Changes without focus change; commit in a card shows the pill in History (Local scope).

## Reference: how JetBrains does it (intellij-community master)
- native/WinFsNotifier/fileWatcher3.c: per-drive recursive RDCW, 16 KB buffer, overflow -> RECDIRTY rescan.
- git4idea GitRepositoryUpdater + GitRepositoryFiles: path list above; commondir split for worktrees.
- UpdateRequestsQueue: one pending request, 300 ms; GitUntrackedFilesHolder: 500 ms.
- VcsLogRefresherImpl: joins newest 1000 commits onto the permanent graph; SelectionSnapshot anchors scroll by commit + pixel offset, follows the top only if already at the top. No banner; silent in place.

## Docs
Update docs/git-history.md: Changes "Refresh model" and History "Refresh is manual" both become stale.

## Later (not this card)
- Swap History to JetBrains' silent anchored behavior if the pill proves annoying (background restream to the anchor, then set scroll_y).
- RepoWatch could replace the board's 5 s STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL (src/kanban.rs).
